name: Welcome To... Chichester : Katherine's Game
source:
A short side-story detailing what happens when Katherine is left alone, whilst Grendel is chasing after the protagonist.

With the computer shop opposite The Council Of The Unseen HQ deciding it wants all it's stolen equipment back, Katherine is forced to play a game of Funopoly - or lose their HQ.

This DLC is now included in the main version
translation:
一个简短的支线故事，详细描述了当凯瑟琳独自一人而格伦德尔在追赶主角时会发生什么。

看不见的委员会总部对面的电脑店决定要回所有被盗的设备，凯瑟琳被迫玩一场Funopoly游戏 - 否则就会失去总部。

该DLC现已包含在主版本中
